title: Intrinsic Task-based Evaluation for Referring Expression Generation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes an intrinsic task-based evaluation for Referring Expression Generation (REG) models, focusing on linguistic qualities like clarity, grammaticality, coherence, and referential success.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the methodology for evaluating Referring Expression Generation models.
